decisions: Live Supabase is the single source of truth for the schema; the repo's baseline migration was reconstructed by inspecting the live database and must stay aligned to it (README, SETUP.md, commit 'Align repo with live Supabase database').

The live database has exactly 10 public tables. There is no `profiles` table (identity comes from Supabase Auth `auth.users`) and no `run_steps` table (the execution timeline and logs live in `research_runs.metadata.steps` JSONB).
Run status uses the value `complete` (not `completed`), and there is no `partial` status (types/index.ts, commit 'Align repo with live Supabase database').

Long-running deep research must never run inside a web request: the web app writes a queued `research_runs` row and hands off to the Trigger.dev `research-run` task; the run detail page reads status from Supabase by polling, never from an in-memory process (README, commit 'Integrate Trigger.dev background jobs').
Use Trigger.dev v4 via `@trigger.dev/sdk` with the `task`/`schemaTask` API; NEVER use the v2 deprecated `client.defineJob` pattern, which breaks the application (CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md).

In production the app must fail fast with a clear config error if Trigger.dev is not configured; the in-process simulated runner (server/actions/run-executor.ts) is a development-only fallback when `TRIGGER_SECRET_KEY` is unset (README execution-modes table).

Production defaults to real research providers and refuses to fall back to the mock provider unless `ALLOW_MOCK_PROVIDER=true` is explicitly set; provider selection is explicit via the `RESEARCH_PROVIDERS` env var (lib/providers/index.ts).

Service-role key (`SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`) and provider API keys (`OPENAI_API_KEY`, `PERPLEXITY_API_KEY`) are server-only and must never reach the browser or be prefixed with `NEXT_PUBLIC_`; the Trigger.dev worker uses the service-role key because it runs outside an authenticated request and always writes the correct user_id.
RLS is enabled on all 10 tables with four per-command policies each (`auth.uid() = user_id`), every table has a `set_updated_at` BEFORE UPDATE trigger, and IDs use `gen_random_uuid()` from pgcrypto.

Provider failures and task errors are always caught and persisted (to `provider_runs.error_message` / `research_runs.error_message`), never silently ignored; if one of several configured providers fails the run continues and only fails when no provider produces output (README, commit 'Preserve provider artifacts when analysis fails').

Launch is gated by count-based guardrails enforced in an atomic DB function: max 3 active (queued/running/paused) runs per project, 5 per user, 25 runs/project/day, and 50 runs/user/day (migrations 20260602140000 and 20260602200618).
Follow-up research loops are bounded: a parent run may spawn child runs for open questions but loops are capped at 3 per project during private beta (migration 20260601090000).
Deep research mode is admin-gated via the `ADMIN_EMAILS` env var; non-admin follow-up loops are downgraded to `standard` (SETUP.md).
The harden migration pins `public.set_updated_at` with a fixed search_path to clear the Supabase security advisor (commit 'Integrate Trigger.dev background jobs', migration 20260530010000).
Keep the stack as Supabase + Vercel + Trigger.dev; per the viability assessment the work needed is product (verification, billing, export), not infrastructure replacement.

Strategic positioning: demote the autonomous research loop to a swappable commodity backend and sell the verification/audit/persistence layer ('research you can defend'); until a real citation-verification pass is benchmarked, claim 'auditable/reviewable', never 'more accurate' (VIABILITY_ASSESSMENT.md).

corrections.old: Schema has 12 tables including a `profiles` table and a `run_steps` table.
corrections.new: Schema has exactly 10 public tables; no `profiles` (identity is `auth.users`) and no `run_steps` (timeline/logs live in `research_runs.metadata.steps`).
corrections.evidence: Commit 2026-05-30 'Align repo with live Supabase database (10-table schema)'; README.md schema section ('earlier drafts incorrectly described a 12-table schema — that has been corrected').

corrections.old: Run status value is `completed` (and a `partial` status exists).
corrections.new: Run status uses `complete` (not `completed`) and there is no `partial` status.
corrections.evidence: Commit 'Align repo with live Supabase database'; types/index.ts; README key-facts list.

corrections.old: Background jobs run via the v2 `client.defineJob` Trigger.dev API.
corrections.new: Trigger.dev v4 with `@trigger.dev/sdk` (`task`/`schemaTask`); `client.defineJob` is deprecated and 'BREAKS APPLICATION'.
corrections.evidence: CLAUDE.md 'NEVER Use (v2 deprecated)' section; trigger.config.ts uses defineConfig with project ref proj_pjaribdquznpuxwkpuyq.

corrections.old: No real research provider; only a deterministic offline mock provider scaffold.
corrections.new: Added an OpenAI provider, then a Perplexity Sonar provider; registry now supports openai, perplexity, and mock selected via RESEARCH_PROVIDERS.
corrections.evidence: Commits 2026-05-31 'Implement OpenAI research provider' and 2026-06-01 'Add Perplexity research provider support'; lib/providers/index.ts registers Mock/OpenAI/Perplexity.

corrections.old: Production silently falls back to the mock provider when no real provider is configured.
corrections.new: Production throws ('No configured real research providers...') unless ALLOW_MOCK_PROVIDER=true is explicitly set.
corrections.evidence: lib/providers/index.ts getResearchProviders(); VIABILITY_ASSESSMENT.md 'Corrections to earlier findings'.

corrections.old: Runs cannot be paused or resumed; statuses are queued/running/complete/failed/cancelled.
corrections.new: Added an explicit `paused` status and pause/resume/stop controls; the status CHECK now allows queued/running/paused/complete/failed/cancelled.
corrections.evidence: Commit 2026-06-02 'Add pause and resume controls for research runs'; migration 20260602200618_add_paused_run_status.sql.

corrections.old: Resuming a queued run always re-dispatches it to Trigger.dev.
corrections.new: If a queued run already has a Trigger.dev handle in its metadata it is reconciled (not re-dispatched); only queued runs without an existing handle are re-scheduled, to avoid duplicate trigger handles.
corrections.evidence: Commit 2026-06-02 'Avoid resuming queued runs with existing trigger handles'; server/actions/run-actions.ts resumeResearchRun (triggerHandleId / reconcileQueuedTriggerRun).

corrections.old: The Perplexity `/v1/sonar` endpoint is a bug and should be `/chat/completions`.
corrections.new: `POST https://api.perplexity.ai/v1/sonar` is the documented canonical endpoint; the legacy `/chat/completions` is an older alias. No code change needed.
corrections.evidence: VIABILITY_ASSESSMENT.md 'Corrections to earlier findings'; lib/providers/perplexity-provider.ts DEFAULT_PERPLEXITY_ENDPOINT = 'https://api.perplexity.ai/v1/sonar'.

corrections.old: set_updated_at function uses the default mutable search_path.
corrections.new: set_updated_at is hardened with a pinned search_path to clear the Supabase security advisor (applied live and recorded as a migration).
corrections.evidence: Commit 'Integrate Trigger.dev background jobs and harden Supabase'; migration 20260530010000_harden_set_updated_at_search_path.sql.

corrections.old: Run launch had no atomicity or count guardrails.
corrections.new: Launch is gated by an atomic DB function enforcing 3 active/project, 5/user, 25 runs/project/day, 50 runs/user/day.
corrections.evidence: Migrations 20260602140000_atomic_research_run_launch.sql and 20260601090000_private_beta_guardrails.sql; commit 'Harden research loop auth, RLS, and run execution flows'.

corrections.old: Supabase clients fell back to a placeholder anon key when env vars were missing.
corrections.new: Clients are typed with Database and fail clearly on missing env (placeholder anon-key fallbacks removed).
corrections.evidence: Commit 'Align repo with live Supabase database' body (lib/supabase/{client,server,middleware} 'fail clearly on missing env; removed placeholder anon-key fallbacks').

qa_pairs.question: How many tables does the live Supabase database have, and which two tables that earlier drafts described do NOT exist?
qa_pairs.expected_fact: Exactly 10 public tables; there is no `profiles` table and no `run_steps` table (earlier 12-table drafts were corrected).
qa_pairs.source: README.md (Database schema section); commit 2026-05-30 'Align repo with live Supabase database (10-table schema)'

qa_pairs.question: Where are the run execution timeline and logs stored, given there is no run_steps table?
qa_pairs.expected_fact: In `research_runs.metadata` JSONB, under `metadata.steps`.

qa_pairs.question: What run status value does the app use for a finished run?
qa_pairs.expected_fact: `complete` (not `completed`); there is also no `partial` status.
qa_pairs.source: README.md key-facts; types/index.ts; commit 'Align repo with live Supabase database'

qa_pairs.question: Which Trigger.dev API must we use and which is forbidden?
qa_pairs.expected_fact: Use Trigger.dev v4 via `@trigger.dev/sdk` (`task`/`schemaTask`); never use the v2 deprecated `client.defineJob`, which breaks the application.
qa_pairs.source: CLAUDE.md 'Trigger.dev Basic Tasks (v4)' and 'NEVER Use (v2 deprecated)'

qa_pairs.question: What is the Trigger.dev project ref for this repo?
qa_pairs.expected_fact: proj_pjaribdquznpuxwkpuyq, set in trigger.config.ts.

qa_pairs.question: What happens in production if Trigger.dev is not configured?
qa_pairs.expected_fact: Runs fail fast with a clear configuration error; the app never runs workers in-process in production. The in-process simulated runner is dev-only (when TRIGGER_SECRET_KEY is unset).

qa_pairs.question: Does production fall back to the mock provider if no real provider is configured?
qa_pairs.expected_fact: No. getResearchProviders() throws unless ALLOW_MOCK_PROVIDER=true is explicitly set; production defaults to openai,perplexity.

qa_pairs.question: How do you enable the Perplexity research provider and what model does it default to?
qa_pairs.expected_fact: Set RESEARCH_PROVIDERS=openai,perplexity and PERPLEXITY_API_KEY (server-only); default model is sonar-deep-research. If the key is missing the provider is skipped safely.

qa_pairs.question: Is the Perplexity `/v1/sonar` endpoint a bug that should be `/chat/completions`?
qa_pairs.expected_fact: No. POST https://api.perplexity.ai/v1/sonar is the documented canonical endpoint; /chat/completions is a legacy alias. No code change needed.

qa_pairs.question: How does the Perplexity provider produce structured output?
qa_pairs.expected_fact: It calls the Sonar API to get a markdown report, then optionally uses OpenAI to normalize that markdown into the same structured ResearchLoop provider output shape (with a fallback if normalization fails).
qa_pairs.source: README.md Research providers; lib/providers/perplexity-provider.ts (normalizeWithOpenAI); commit 'Handle Perplexity normalization failures and add cost accounting'

qa_pairs.question: What are the count-based launch guardrails for research runs?
qa_pairs.expected_fact: Max 3 active (queued/running/paused) runs per project, 5 per user, 25 runs/project/day, and 50 runs/user/day, enforced atomically in a DB function.

qa_pairs.question: What is the follow-up research loop limit?
qa_pairs.expected_fact: Loops are bounded to a maximum of 3 per project during private beta (and limited to one child run per loop).

qa_pairs.question: What was added in the paused-run-status change and why?
qa_pairs.expected_fact: An explicit `paused` status plus pause/resume/stop controls; the status CHECK constraint was expanded to queued/running/paused/complete/failed/cancelled.
qa_pairs.source: commit 2026-06-02 'Add pause and resume controls for research runs'; migration 20260602200618_add_paused_run_status.sql

qa_pairs.question: Why must resuming a queued run avoid re-dispatching it to Trigger.dev?
qa_pairs.expected_fact: If the queued run already has a Trigger.dev handle in its metadata, it is reconciled instead of re-dispatched, to avoid creating duplicate trigger handles; only handle-less queued runs are re-scheduled.
qa_pairs.source: commit 2026-06-02 'Avoid resuming queued runs with existing trigger handles'; server/actions/run-actions.ts resumeResearchRun

qa_pairs.question: Which keys are server-only and must never reach the browser?
qa_pairs.expected_fact: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY (bypasses RLS), OPENAI_API_KEY, and PERPLEXITY_API_KEY; never prefix them with NEXT_PUBLIC_. The Trigger.dev worker uses the service-role key and always writes the correct user_id.

qa_pairs.question: How is RLS configured across the schema?
qa_pairs.expected_fact: RLS is enabled on all 10 tables with four per-command policies each (auth.uid() = user_id); every table has a set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE trigger and IDs use gen_random_uuid() (pgcrypto).

qa_pairs.question: What did the set_updated_at hardening migration fix?
qa_pairs.expected_fact: It pinned public.set_updated_at with a fixed search_path to clear the Supabase security advisor warning.
qa_pairs.source: supabase/migrations/20260530010000_harden_set_updated_at_search_path.sql; commit 'Integrate Trigger.dev background jobs and harden Supabase'

qa_pairs.question: How is deep research mode restricted?
qa_pairs.expected_fact: Deep mode is admin-gated via the ADMIN_EMAILS env var; non-admin follow-up loops are downgraded to standard.

qa_pairs.question: What is the storage bucket setup, and what is the `tickets` bucket?
qa_pairs.expected_fact: One private bucket `researchloop-files` (folder convention {user_id}/{project_id}/filename) with owner-folder policies; `tickets` is an unrelated public bucket not part of ResearchLoop and should be reviewed/removed.

qa_pairs.question: What is the headline verdict and strategy of the viability assessment?
qa_pairs.expected_fact: Conditional yes: the autonomous research loop is a commodity (APIs sell it for ~$0.41–$5), so demote the loop to a swappable backend and sell the verification/audit/persistence layer ('research you can defend'); claim 'auditable', not 'more accurate', until citation verification is built and benchmarked.

qa_pairs.question: What are the local dev validation commands before running the app?
qa_pairs.expected_fact: npm install; npm run lint; npm run typecheck; npm run test; npm run dev (and npm run trigger:dev for the real worker). App runs at http://localhost:3000 and redirects to /login.
